name: Indonesian (Advanced Language Study)
description: Certificate of Advanced Language Study in Indonesian offered by the Department of Southeast Asian Studies. Once certified, the certificate is listed on student transcripts.
notes: Letter grade B or above required in all courses
Declare candidacy on Yale Hub as early as possible, no later than January 15 or September 15 of final semester
With adviser approval, up to one course conducted in Indonesian at the appropriate advanced level may count (e.g., INDN 4700 or INDN 4710 graded pass/fail, or graduate seminar INDN 5700)
Up to two study-abroad credits taught in Indonesian may be substituted with adviser approval

requirements.name: Courses beyond L4
requirements.description: Four courses beyond the L4 level in Indonesian. At least two must be Yale advanced language courses (e.g., INDN 1500, INDN 1600, INDN 1700, or INDN 1800).
